newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends lower on profit-taking.

text.p: London's October white sugar contract settled softer on Wednesday after profit taking pared gains from a fund-led rally earlier this week.
October ended $1.50 easier at $328.20, after hitting a contract high of $330.20 on Tuesday.
Meanwhile December ended down $1.30 at $322.50. Total volume was 1,804 lots.
The market was abuzz with talk of the increased fund position in London and how trade players would react to it.
October also dominated activity in Paris, ending down down $0.40 at $327.40. December was down $0.80 cents at $322.20.
